en: How can I get my certificate?
When will I get my certificate?
Who is eligible for a certificate?
What do I need to complete for a certificate?
or: certificate pain kana complete karibaku padiba
hi: certificate ke liye kaun eligible hai
certificate ke liye kya complete karna hoga

answers.en: Certificate eligibility depends on completing the required course or internship requirements defined by Tech Monster. Check your dashboard for your completion status and certificate availability.
answers.or: Certificate eligibility Tech Monster ra required course ba internship requirements complete kariba upare depend kare. Dashboard re completion status au certificate availability check kara.
answers.hi: Certificate eligibility Tech Monster ke required course ya internship requirements complete karne par depend karti hai. Dashboard mein completion status aur certificate availability check karein.
answers.mixed: Certificate eligibility Tech Monster ra required course ba internship requirements complete kariba upare depend kare. Dashboard re status check kara.

en: How do I download my certificate?
Where can I download my certificate?
Where is my certificate download option?
hi: kya main certificate download kar sakta hoon

answers.en: If your certificate is available, open the certificate section from your dashboard and use the available download option.
answers.or: Jadi certificate available achhi, dashboard ru certificate section open kari available download option use kara.
answers.hi: Agar aapka certificate available hai, to dashboard se certificate section open karke available download option use karein.
answers.mixed: Certificate available thile dashboard ru certificate section open kari download option use kara.

en: I completed everything but my certificate is missing
Why is my certificate not available?
or: mu sabu complete karichi kintu certificate miluni
hi: mera certificate show nahi ho raha hai
maine sab complete kiya lekin certificate nahi mila
mera certificate available kyu nahi hai
mera certificate nahi dikh raha hai
mixed: mu sabu complete karichi but certificate miluni

answers.en: If you have completed all required requirements but your certificate is still unavailable, please contact the support team so they can check your completion and certificate status.
answers.or: Jadi tume required sabu requirement complete karichha kintu certificate tathapi available nahi, support team ku contact kara. Semane tumara completion au certificate status check kariparibe.
answers.hi: Agar aapne sabhi required requirements complete kar li hain lekin certificate abhi bhi available nahi hai, to support team se contact karein. Woh aapka completion aur certificate status check kar sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Jadi required sabu complete karichha but certificate available nahi, support team ku contact kara. Semane completion au certificate status check karibe.
